text: {"name":"get_frame_info","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns the global frame-info value when the auxiliary descriptor's bit 9 is set; otherwise it returns the stored value for a nonnegative status field or synthesizes a fallback from the context byte.","subsystem":"tx","var_renames":{"v2":"aux_descriptor"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":68,"meaning":"Pointer to an auxiliary descriptor whose 16-bit flags at offset 8 are tested."},{"offset":8,"meaning":"16-bit descriptor flags; bit 9 selects the global frame-info value."},{"offset":44,"meaning":"Pointer to a record whose signed field at offset 60 controls which frame-info value is used."},{"offset":60,"meaning":"Signed status or validity field; nonnegative selects the stored frame-info word."},{"offset":580,"meaning":"Stored frame-info word returned when the status field is nonnegative."},{"offset":309,"meaning":"Fallback byte shifted into the synthesized frame-info word."}]}
